title: seed: re-base an installed demo dataset seed dates, so an aged demo tenant does not drift into overdue deals and missed SLAs
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

## Source

From HotCRM card objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2431, landed as hotcrm#2433. The maintainer agreed to filing this card at **p3** (2026-11-12T09:47Z).

## The gap (measured on @objectstack 18.3.0)

- HotCRM's demo seed dates are CEL offsets from the seeding moment (`daysAgo` / `daysFromNow`). A fresh install is therefore current.
- They are evaluated once, at install. A staging tenant that was 26 days old showed this:
  - open negotiation deals whose expected close dates were in the past;
  - 23 of 30 open cases past SLA;
  - a "last 30 days" chart covering only four days.
- The platform has no way to re-base an installed demo dataset to today, short of deleting and reseeding it.

## What would close it

Any of these:
- A "refresh demo data" action that re-evaluates a dataset's date expressions and shifts the stored rows by the elapsed time.
- A reseed that keeps user-created rows.
- A documented, supported reseed path.

## hotcrm half

- hotcrm#2433 documents the reseed path in its admin docs.
- A guard test now refuses a literal date in any seed row.
